name: Camping 101: Alchemy
summary: As an alchemist, you can learn to craft a Mana Well for your camp. Carolai Anise in Brill can teach you once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

sections.title: A camp for brews
sections.body: Carolai Anise can teach you to craft a Mana Well, a camping item for your profession. Once you know the craft, you can set up camp in the wilderness. A campfire is needed to start your camp, and cooks can teach you how to make one.

faq.q: Who teaches me to craft a Mana Well?
faq.answer: Carolai Anise in Brill can teach you to craft a Mana Well once you have shown proficiency in your alchemy skill.

faq.q: What is a Mana Well for?
faq.answer: A Mana Well is a camping item you can craft as an alchemist. Healers and spellcasters are drawn to it for a refreshing taste.

faq.q: Where can I learn the Mana Well craft?
faq.answer: You can learn the craft from Carolai Anise in Brill.

faq.q: What do I need before starting a camp?
faq.answer: You need a campfire before you start your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make one.
